http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#com:
Georeferencing activity (FSL CM pattern). All 10 CM properties:
  P5  fsl:certaintyLevel     → fsl:CertaintyType (derived from genauigkeit_m:
                                 <Q23> high <50m, <Q15> medium 50-500m,
                                 <Q24> low >500m, <Q113> dubious)
  P6  fsl:hasSourceType      → fsl:SourceType Named Node (quellen_typ)
  P7  fsl:methodUsed         → fsl:MethodType Named Node (methode)
  P13 fsl:certaintyDesc      → xsd:string (methodenbeschr)
  P14 fsl:georeferencingBy   → <https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4696-2101> (fixed)
      prov:wasAssociatedWith → <https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4696-2101> (fixed)
  P15 fsl:activityDesc       → xsd:string (methodenbeschr)
  P16 fsl:hasSourceTypeDetail→ fsl:SourceType Named Node (quellen_typ, detail)
  P23 fsl:precision          → xsd:decimal on bb5kbc:Fundstelle (genauigkeit_m)
  P24 fsl:hasLocationType    → <Q80> Findspot (fixed for all bb5kbc:Fundstelle)
  P25 fsl:hasReference       → xsd:string (quelle_georef)
  P33 fsl:hasPointType       → <Q126> Representative Point (fixed for all sf:Point)
